title: 第567章 察地理修水利劝农桑第566章 玄天宗弟子入各地为官
slug: 她本凤命我以风水改乾坤
content_zh:
玄天宗弟子入各地为官，如同一股清流，注入了日渐僵化的地方官僚体系。他们不尚空谈，注重实干，到任后的第一件事，便是脱去官服，换上便装，深入田间地头，实地勘察当地的地理环境。
沈默被任命为山东济南府下属一个县的县令。他到任后，没有急着升堂审案，也没有忙着拜会上司乡绅，而是带着一个包袱，里面装着罗盘、纸笔和几块干粮，独自一人，走遍了县内的每一座山头、每一条河流。
他发现，这个县虽然地处平原，但地势整体呈现出北高南低的倾斜。北部靠近黄河的区域，因为地势较高，地下水埋藏较深，灌溉困难，农田多为旱地，收成全靠老天爷赏脸。而南部靠近一片名为“巨野泽”的湖泊区域，地势低洼，地下水丰富，但因为排水不畅，一到雨季便容易形成内涝，农田常常被淹。
沈默将观察到的地形地貌、水文特征、土壤类型，详细地绘制成了一幅《县域地理水文图》。然后，他根据这幅图，制定了一套极具针对性的水利建设方案。
在北部旱区，他指导百姓开挖了一种名为“坎儿井”的简易地下暗渠。这种暗渠，源自西域，林墨在《风水要略》中曾有提及，沈默将其因地制宜地进行了改良。他带领百姓，在地下数米深处，开挖出一条条相互连通的隧道，将北部山区渗入地下的少量地下水，引导到地势较低的农田附近，再通过出口处的明渠，灌溉田地。这种暗渠，蒸发量极小，即使在干旱的季节，也能保持稳定的水流。
在南部涝区，沈默则组织百姓，疏浚了多条淤塞的河道，并开挖了一条新的排水渠，将多余的积水，引导到巨野泽中。同时，他还指导百姓，在低洼的田地中，开挖出一种名为“沟洫畦田”的排灌系统，即在田地中开挖纵横交错的排水沟，将田地分割成一块块长方形的“畦”，既便于排水，又便于灌溉。
沈默的这一系列举措，极大地改善了当地的农业生产条件。第二年，全县的粮食产量，便比往年增加了四成以上。百姓们敲锣打鼓，给沈默送来了一把万民伞，上面密密麻麻地签满了名字和手印。
与此同时，在河南任职的另一位玄天宗弟子，也做出了不俗的成绩。他发现，当地黄河大堤频繁溃决的根源，不仅仅在于堤坝不够坚固，更在于河道本身的走向存在问题。有一段河道，形成了一个近乎直角的急转弯，洪水到此，流速骤然减缓，泥沙大量沉积，导致河床不断抬高，形成了“地上河”，对堤坝造成了巨大的压力。
这名弟子，大胆地提出了一个“裁弯取直”的方案。他建议，在那段急转弯处，开挖一条新的、更加顺直的河道，将原来的弯曲河道废弃。这样一来，洪水可以更加顺畅地通过，减少了泥沙沉积，也减轻了对堤坝的压力。
这个方案，虽然工程量巨大，但一旦成功，效果将是长期的。林墨在京城看到这名弟子呈送上来的方案后，大为赞赏，并亲自向新帝做了汇报。新帝当即批准了这个方案，并拨付了专项经费。
在工部官员和当地驻军的配合下，这项“裁弯取直”工程，历时半年，终于完工。当年汛期，黄河水流量虽然比往年更大，但那段河道，却安然无恙，没有发生任何险情。当地百姓，悬了多年的心，终于放了下来。
在陕西，一位玄天宗弟子，则将重点放在了“劝农桑”上。他发现，当地百姓种植的作物品种单一，耕作方式落后，产量低下。他利用自己在历局学到的知识，以及林墨编写的《农事手册》，在当地推广了一套更加科学的耕作制度。
他指导百姓，将小麦与豆类进行轮作，利用豆科植物的固氮作用，提高土壤肥力。他引进了一种名为“占城稻”的早熟水稻品种，这种水稻耐旱、生长周期短，可以在关中地区的一年两熟制中，发挥重要作用。他还推广了“桑基鱼塘”的生态农业模式，在池塘边种植桑树，用桑叶养蚕，用蚕沙喂鱼，用塘泥肥田，形成了一种良性循环的生态系统。
几年后，陕西的这个县，从一个贫困县，变成了远近闻名的富裕县。百姓们住上了新房子，穿上了新衣裳，孩子们也都有了读书的机会。
玄天宗弟子们在各地的出色表现，让新帝对林墨的先见之明，更加佩服。他意识到，选拔实用型人才，充实到地方官队伍中，对于改善民生、促进发展，具有多么重要的意义。他决定，将这一做法，作为一项长期的政策，坚持下去。

content_en:
Disciples of Xuantian Sect became officials in various places, which was like a breath of fresh air, injecting into the increasingly rigid local bureaucracy system. They don't talk empty talk, but pay attention to practical work. The first thing they do after taking office is to take off their official uniforms, put on civilian clothes, go deep into the fields, and conduct on-the-spot surveys of the local geographical environment.
Shen Mo was appointed as the magistrate of a county under Jinan Prefecture, Shandong. After he took office, he did not rush to court to hear the case, nor did he rush to visit his boss, the squire. Instead, he took a bag containing a compass, paper and pen and a few pieces of dry food, and traveled alone to every mountain and every river in the county.
He found that although this county is located in a plain, the overall terrain shows a slope that is higher in the north and lower in the south. In the northern area near the Yellow River, because the terrain is high and the groundwater is deeply buried, irrigation is difficult. Most of the farmland is dry land, and the harvest depends entirely on God's favor. The southern part is close to a lake area called "Juye Ze", which is low-lying and rich in groundwater. However, due to poor drainage, waterlogging is easy to occur during the rainy season, and farmland is often flooded.
Silence drew the observed topography, hydrological characteristics, and soil types in detail into a "County Geography and Hydrology Map." Then, based on this picture, he formulated a highly targeted water conservancy construction plan.
In the arid northern region, he guided the people to dig a simple underground ditch called a "karez". This kind of culvert originated from the Western Regions. Lin Mo mentioned it in "Feng Shui Essentials", and Shen Mo improved it according to local conditions. He led the people to dig interconnected tunnels several meters deep underground to guide a small amount of groundwater that seeped into the ground from the northern mountainous area to near lower-lying farmland, and then irrigated the fields through open channels at the exits. This kind of underdrain has very little evaporation and can maintain a stable flow of water even in dry seasons.
In the southern waterlogged area, Silence organized people to dredge many blocked rivers and dug a new drainage channel to guide the excess water into Juye Ze. At the same time, he also guided the people to dig out a drainage and irrigation system called "ditch and furrow" in low-lying fields. That is, crisscrossing drainage ditches were dug in the fields and divided into rectangular "fringes" to facilitate both drainage and irrigation.
This series of silent measures has greatly improved local agricultural production conditions. In the second year, the county's grain output increased by more than 40% compared with previous years. The common people beat gongs and drums and brought a Wanmin umbrella to Shen Mo, which was densely filled with names and fingerprints.
At the same time, another Xuantian Sect disciple working in Henan also made outstanding achievements. He found that the root cause of the frequent breaches of the local Yellow River levees was not only that the levees were not strong enough, but also that there were problems with the direction of the river itself. There is a section of the river that forms a sharp turn at an almost right angle. When the flood reaches this point, the flow speed suddenly slows down, and a large amount of sediment is deposited, causing the river bed to continuously rise, forming an "above ground river", which puts huge pressure on the dam.
This disciple boldly proposed a plan to "cut the crooked and make it straight". He suggested that a new, straighter river channel be dug at that sharp bend and the original curved river channel be abandoned. In this way, floodwaters can pass more smoothly, reducing sediment deposition and reducing pressure on the dams.
Although this plan requires a huge amount of work, once successful, the effects will be long-term. After Lin Mo saw the plan submitted by this disciple in the capital, he greatly appreciated it and reported it to the new emperor in person. The new emperor immediately approved the plan and allocated special funds.
With the cooperation of officials from the Ministry of Industry and the local garrison, this "cutting off curves and making straight" project took half a year and was finally completed. During the flood season that year, although the water flow of the Yellow River was greater than in previous years, that section of the river was safe and sound without any danger. The local people, who had been worried for many years, finally let go.down.
In Shaanxi, a disciple of the Xuantian Sect focused on "encouraging farmers and mulberry trees". He found that the local people planted a single variety of crops, had backward farming methods, and had low yields. He used the knowledge he learned in Liju and the "Farming Manual" written by Lin Mo to promote a more scientific farming system in the local area.
He guided the people to rotate wheat with beans and utilize the nitrogen fixation of leguminous plants to improve soil fertility. He introduced an early-maturing rice variety called "Champa Rice", which is drought-resistant and has a short growth cycle. It can play an important role in the two-crop-a-year system in the Guanzhong area. He also promoted the ecological agriculture model of "mulberry-based fish pond", planting mulberry trees beside the pond, raising silkworms with mulberry leaves, feeding fish with silkworm excrement, and fertilizing the fields with pond mud, forming a virtuous cycle ecosystem.
A few years later, this county in Shaanxi changed from a poor county to a well-known wealthy county. The people lived in new houses and wore new clothes, and the children also had the opportunity to study.
The outstanding performance of Xuantian Sect disciples in various places made the new emperor admire Lin Mo's foresight even more. He realized how important it was to select practical talents and enrich them into the ranks of local officials to improve people's livelihood and promote development. He decided to stick to this approach as a long-term policy.
